description: Shared golden vectors for the per-move CPL cap normalizer (g-no51): centipawn_loss (Python) / evalLoss (TS). Pins the 0..1000 cap and the >=0 floor both runtimes must agree on. Consumed by backend/test_centipawn_loss.py and src/workers/analysisUtils.test.ts. Runtime-specific inputs (TS Infinity/NaN; Python None edge) stay in their own suites; the shared null vector covers the null->null contract.
